review_notes: API accepts revoke message and passes reason/message through preview and confirm.
Service normalized revoke spec persists trimmed reason/message; confirm reconstructs from preview spec and sets ExpectedVersion from preview target.
Audit event authorization.assignment.revoked includes request_id from the batch idempotency key and payload status plus reason/message when reason is non-empty.
UI freezes grant_ids, reason, message, preview_id, token, and stable idempotency_key at preview success, so later reason edits do not mutate confirm payload.
Security boundary remains fail-closed through requireRevokeAllowed, resolveRevokeTarget org checks, preview actor/org/token/hash checks, and custom-role-only revoke projection.
